'''Jason Dennee''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[2000 Decipher World Championship]] in October 2000 with [[Mind What You Have Learned / Save You It Can|MWYHL]], according to Tim Guzman's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1317">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-10-10-info-brokers-dcon-day-one-reportd1317/ info-brokers-dcon-day-one-report], DeckTech (Tim "Info Broker" Guzman, 10 October 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-10-10-info-brokers-dcon-day-one-reportd1317/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
